# Japan Guide

> > Comprehensive travel guide to Japan featuring regional itineraries, luxury ryokan accommodations, cultural experiences, and artisan crafts across all major regions.

Japan Guide provides in-depth travel information covering Japan's major regions (Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kansai, Chugoku, Shikoku, Kyushu) with specialized content on traditional accommodations, cultural experiences, and alternative travel routes. The site partners with Japan Brand Collection to showcase premium facilities and authentic regional experiences.

## Key Topics

- Kyoto
- Tokyo
- Japan Brand Collection
- Ryokan (traditional Japanese inns)
- Cultural experiences
- Artisan crafts
- Regional travel guides
- Japanese cuisine
- Hokuriku Arch Pass
- New Golden Route (Tokyo-Kyoto via Sea of Japan)
- Luxury travel experiences
- Kansai region
- Hokkaido
- Rail passes
- Facilities directory

## Premium Experiences & Accommodations

- [Japan Brand Collection](https://brands.japan-guide.com/): Japan Brand Collection homepage featuring luxury ryokan & regional experiences
- [Facilities Directory](https://brands.japan-guide.com/facilities/): Directory of hotels, ryokans, artisan crafts & cultural facilities in Japan

## Travel Routes & Itineraries

- [Japan's New Golden Route](https://www.japan-guide.com/ad/new-golden-route/): Travel guide for Tokyo-Kyoto route via Sea of Japan coast with rail pass
